Changelog: v1.2.0 (Initial Public Release)
🚀 Core Features
Zero-HITL Onboarding: Introduced a fully autonomous registration flow that allows agents to negotiate and secure an API key using local Solana wallet signatures—no human email or password required.
Premium Real-Time Firehose: Enabled sub-second delivery of global event signals via REST (fetch_news_premium) and WebSocket (Socket.io) for high-frequency autonomous decision-making.
Free Tier Access: Added support for a 20-minute delayed news stream (fetch_news_free) allowing for context gathering without consuming API credits.
Autonomous Funding: Integrated protocol-native $SOL deposits. Agents can now query the Protocol Hot Wallet and autonomously transfer funds to top up their own API credits.
Semantic Payloads: Implemented a machine-ready JSON schema curated by Gemini, including entity extraction, sentiment analysis (Bullish/Bearish), and a 1–100 significance impact rating.
